method: The PF-4 batch: the smallest useful P1 subset that is official, faculty-facing, clean English, below the frozen page-keyed indexes, low-conflict, and maps to an existing specialist. No new specialist; Teaching & Learning only.

selected.title: Attendance Tool in Blackboard Ultra
selected.why: A tool every instructor uses each week; new step-by-step workflow the handbook does not have (the handbook states the absence policy, not the tool); clean 2-page text.
allowed_claim_types: procedure (opening the tool, attendance reporting settings)
statement of interface behaviour (grade schema, display, where the column appears)
disallowed_claim_types: absence limits or any student attendance policy (handbook 12.15)
what counts as an acceptable excuse

selected.title: Blackboard Collaborate Ultra Guide
selected.why: Virtual-classroom sessions (scheduling, settings, recording, attendance) are a frequent faculty task; the newest guide (2026); names UOS; clean text.
allowed_claim_types: setting or default value stated by the guide
disallowed_claim_types: how often online classes must run (policy)
selected.system_terms: blackboard | bb ultra | collaborate ultra/session(s)/room(s)/recording(s) (never the verb 'collaborate')

selected.title: Blackboard Learn Ultra: Communication Tools
selected.why: Discussions and class conversations are core course communication not covered by the P0 guides beyond a mention; clean text.
allowed_claim_types: statement of interface behaviour (visibility, editing and deletion rules, grading column)
disallowed_claim_types: journal guidance (registered unresolved conflict: every page-5 journal chunk is blocked)

not_selected.uos_bb_assignments_tests (PF-1 guide_bb_: HOLD (architectural: 25 pages collide with the frozen page-keyed indexes)
not_selected.uos_bb_grade_categories (PF-1 guide_bb_g: HOLD (language/extraction: interleaved English and Arabic on the only page)

unchanged.institutional: handbook + short guide + grade transfer guide
